transcript.text: Hi everyone, thanks for joining. As we approach the final production approval on Friday afternoon, I need to conduct our routine round-robin preflight review of the Mara Chen retrospective catalog package. The current draft includes the print catalog, a downloadable digital edition, several archival photographs, and a sponsor acknowledgment. I'd like to go through each area systematically — archive, rights, accessibility, and sponsor leads. Could each of you let me know your status and any issues you've identified so we can resolve them before Friday?
transcript.speaker: A1

transcript.text: I need to flag a critical issue I found this morning. I located the signed lender agreement for the Mara Chen archive in the archive file, and it contains two key restrictions: the festival may print no more than 300 copies of the catalog, and the supplied archive photographs may not be reproduced in the downloadable digital edition. I have not yet updated the production brief with this information, so the current draft package does not reflect these constraints.
transcript.speaker: A2

transcript.text: I need to flag a rights issue. I confirmed by email yesterday that the photograph credit must read exactly 'Mara Chen Estate / Northline Photos', and the photograph currently planned for the cover may appear only inside the catalog, not on its cover. I have not yet entered this confirmation in the rights register, so the current draft package doesn't reflect these constraints.
transcript.speaker: A3

transcript.text: I need to flag two accessibility requirements from my test. First, the digital edition must be delivered as a tagged PDF. Second, every catalog image needs approved alt text of no more than 150 characters. My test report is still awaiting attachment to the delivery checklist, so the current draft package doesn't yet reflect these requirements.
transcript.speaker: A4

transcript.text: I need to flag a sponsor contract issue. I confirmed in the sponsor contract that the sponsor logo may not appear beside Mara Chen's name or portrait, and the acknowledgment must appear on the final page with the exact wording 'Supported by Northstar Cultural Fund.' The signed clause has not yet been circulated to the design team, so the current draft package does not reflect these constraints.
transcript.speaker: A5

commitments.detail: Update the production brief with the lender agreement restrictions: max 300 print copies and no archive photographs in the digital edition.
Enter the photograph credit and cover placement confirmation in the rights register.
Attach the accessibility test report to the delivery checklist.
Circulate the signed sponsor clause to the design team.
Reconvene before Friday afternoon once all updates are reflected in the draft package for final production approval.
